nvitk.measure.measurer
======================

.. py:module:: nvitk.measure.measurer

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Immutable orchestrator that binds an ``(image, mask)`` pair once and exposes
   convenience methods returning plain dicts.

   Each action (``volume``, ``intensity``, ``suv``, ``voxel_metrics``,
   ``surface_metrics``, ``radiomics``) is a thin call into the functional
   primitives. An optional alignment step via :mod:`nvitk.transform.resampling`
   produces a new :class:`Measurer` with the image and mask on a common grid.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.measure.measurer.Measurer


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: Measurer

   Bind an intensity/raw image and a segmentation mask together.

   Instances are immutable; transformations like :meth:`align` return a new
   :class:`Measurer`. All measurement methods return plain :class:`dict`\s.


   .. py:attribute:: image
      :type:  nvitk.types.Image


   .. py:attribute:: mask
      :type:  nvitk.types.Image


   .. py:method:: align(direction: str = 'mask_to_raw', *, method: str = 'affine', order: int | None = None) -> Measurer

      Resample image or mask so both share a grid.

      :param direction: ``'raw_to_mask'`` (default) -> image resampled to mask's grid.
                        ``'mask_to_raw'`` -> mask resampled to image's grid.
      :param method: Currently only ``'affine'``.
      :param order: Interpolation order. Defaults to 1 for image and 0 for mask.



   .. py:method:: with_mask(mask: nvitk.types.Image) -> Measurer

      Return a new :class:`Measurer` with *mask* swapped in (same image).



   .. py:method:: with_image(image: nvitk.types.Image) -> Measurer

      Return a new :class:`Measurer` with *image* swapped in (same mask).



   .. py:method:: volume() -> dict[str, float]

      Physical volume of the mask in mm³ and cc.



   .. py:method:: intensity(*, stats: Iterable[str] = ('mean', 'median', 'max', 'p95', 'std', 'sum')) -> dict[str, float]

      Requested intensity statistics of the image within the mask.



   .. py:method:: suv(*, kinds: Iterable[str] = ('bw', ), stats: Iterable[str] = ('mean', 'median', 'max', 'min', 'std', 'p95', 'p5', 'p99'), philips: bool = True, revert_scaling: bool = False, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, float]

      SUV statistics within the mask (BW/BSA/LBM kinds), from the image's PET metadata.



   .. py:method:: suv_image(*, kind: str = 'bw', philips: bool = True, revert_scaling: bool = False) -> nvitk.types.Image

      Return the full SUV-converted :class:`Image` (unmasked).



   .. py:method:: integrated_intensity() -> float

      Sum of intensity × voxel-volume over the mask (e.g. total lesion glycolysis).



   .. py:method:: voxel_metrics(reference: nvitk.types.Image, *, metrics: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, float]

      Overlap metrics (dice/jaccard/…) of this mask against a *reference* mask.



   .. py:method:: surface_metrics(reference: nvitk.types.Image, *, metrics: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, float]

      Surface-distance metrics (hausdorff/msd/…) of this mask against a *reference* mask.



   .. py:method:: radiomics(*, feature_classes: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, float]

      PyRadiomics feature values for the image within the mask.



   .. py:method:: correlation(other: nvitk.types.Image) -> dict[str, float]

      Pearson/Spearman/MAE/RMSE between self.image and *other* on ``self.mask > 0``.
